description: This Java class handles the deletion of SMS messages within the Fineract project. It processes delete commands for SMS entities and interacts with the SmsWritePlatformService to perform the deletion.

classes.name: DeleteSmsCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles delete commands for SMS messages, annotated with @CommandType for entity 'SMS' and action 'DELETE'.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command for an SMS by calling the delete method on the SmsWritePlatformService with the entity ID extracted from the command.
